IEEE CS Nirma · Mission & Vision

About Our Chapter

Building technical curiosity, mentoring young engineers, and empowering computing innovation across Nirma University.

Chapter Overview

The IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter at Nirma University was established to inspire and mentor young engineers passionate about computing, cybersecurity, and emerging technology.

We organize hands-on workshops, technical competitions, research programs, and networking events throughout the academic year, giving students a platform to build real skills beyond the classroom.

Our flagship event, HackIEEE, brings together developers, engineers, and tech enthusiasts to build tomorrow's solutions.

Chapter Values

  • Learn by doing — practical code over passive theory
  • No prerequisites — curiosity and effort are enough
  • Open source and community-first development
  • Research and innovation beyond standard coursework
